source_hypotheses.discharge: E_l has Delta2304*l^6 nonzero. BCDT final TheoremA unconditional for elliptic curves.

constructed_objects.required: Same E, conductorN(E), rational normalized eigenform and actual quotient.
constructed_objects.discharge: Shimura Gamma0 quotient, dimension1; actual E recovered by Q-isogeny, not relabeled optimal curve.

index_domain_coverage.required: Every actual l/twist used, not merely one tabulated curve or fixed residual case.
index_domain_coverage.discharge: General theorem applies separately to each elliptic curve; positivity/squarefreeness is supplied upstream, not reproved.

transition_maps.required: q_f, alpha, Abel–Jacobi map and exact Hecke action.
transition_maps.discharge: phi=alpha q_f, pi(x)=phi([x]-[infinity]); normalized and nonconstant, phi T_q=[a_q]phi.

limiting_object_identity.required: Actual E Tate module, not integral identification with A_f.
limiting_object_identity.discharge: Faltings identifies rational isogeny class; finite lattice index retained. No limiting Selmer claim is inferred.

coefficient_conventions.required: Weight2, coefficient fieldQ, trivial character and same conductor.
coefficient_conventions.discharge: Integral L-series coefficients and cyclotomic determinant give the rational Gamma0 realization; dimA_f=1. No Fricke condition needed for Gamma0 case.

local_conditions.required: Good Euler factors at almost every prime suffice for same-field isogeny.
local_conditions.discharge: Faltings Corollary2 applies overQ; no unproved equality at bad factors or ordinary-at2 assumption.

exceptional_cases.required: Full rational2-torsion, CM curves, isogeny direction, and source normalization.
exceptional_cases.discharge: BCDT covers all; alpha is oriented A_f->E; opposite Abel–Jacobi sign is harmless. No Manin-constant=1 premise.

downstream_consumption.required: Forward modularity and fixed actual parametrization only.
downstream_consumption.discharge: Restricted converse, simultaneous producer and witness assembly remain separate; no surface-Pan realization acceptance.

preserved_limits: Semantic final selected statements only; no fresh BCDT final PDF hash.
No RC, integral/calibration, actual prime/pole producer or all-row acceptance.
supplemental_source: Agashe–Ribet–Stein2006 pp617–618 supplies published corroboration of the actual rational quotient; original construction is checked in Shimura1973 and Faltings1983/1984.
